docs.question: Which weather condition groups count as precipitation?
docs.answer: In the weather dimension, only two condition groups are flagged as precipitation: Rain (2 codes) and Snow (1 code). The other groups present, Clear and Clouds, are not counted as precipitation; no Drizzle or Thunderstorm conditions appear in the data.
docs.sql: SELECT condition_group, COUNT(*) AS codes, MAX(CASE WHEN is_precipitation THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END) AS counts_as_precipitation FROM marts.dim_weather GROUP BY condition_group ORDER BY condition_group LIMIT 200

docs.question: Which 3 stations have the highest peak-hour shortage rate?
docs.answer: The three stations with the highest peak-hour shortage rates are PHIBSBOROUGH ROAD (inner zone, 40 docks), which was empty for 100% of its observed peak minutes; GOLDEN LANE (city centre, 20 docks), at 70.7%; and PORTOBELLO ROAD (inner zone, 30 docks), at 59.9%. Note that these rates are based on fairly small amounts of peak-hour data (roughly 64-75 observed minutes each).
